# P04: Early modern encounters and competing sovereignties

**Window:** 1498–1791 CE; editorial window.

**Question:** How did overseas powers interact with existing local institutions and maritime networks?

## Evidence presently available in this seed

The voyage journal excerpt places the Portuguese arrival account at Calicut in 1498. The prior Periplus evidence demonstrates that maritime exchange long predates that arrival.

Source routes: [S021](../sources/S021.md), [S022](../sources/S022.md), [S016](../sources/S016.md), [S024](../sources/S024.md).

## What this does not establish

The year does not mark the discovery of an unknown or uninhabited coast. Accounts by travellers are situated testimony, including misidentification, rhetoric and hostility.
